newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian cowboy Manoelzao dies aged 92.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian cowboy Manoelzao dies aged 92.

text.p: Manoel Nardy, a legendary Brazilian cowboy and a central character in a classic novel, Joao Guimaraes Rosa's "Grande Sertao: Veredas", has died of heart disease at the age of 92.
Nardy, better known as Manoelzao (Big Manoel), died in Belo Horizonte on Monday.

In the early 1950s, he led Guimaraes Rosa, Brazil's most acclaimed modern author, across the dusty scrubland of the central savannah or "sertao". The result was "Grande Sertao: Veredas", in which the author narrates the rough outdoor life of Brazil's disappearing cowboy breed.
Guimaraes Rosa, who died in 1967, was charmed by Nardy's hard drinking, his rustic philosophy and his story-telling.
Nardy, thin and bearded, later rose to national fame after starring in a television mini-series based on the novel.
"Rosa was the best thing that ever happened to me," Nardy once said.
